WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    AlbumId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_price,
    CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) as bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_ratio
  FROM step1
  WHERE bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  s1.AlbumId,
  s1.avg_price,
  s1.bytes_per_ms,
  s1.bytes_per_ms - s2.avg_ratio as difference
FROM step1 s1
CROSS JOIN step2 s2
WHERE s2.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN (s1.bytes_per_ms - s2.avg_ratio) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  (s1.bytes_per_ms - s2.avg_ratio) DESC
LIMIT 10
